outlet.name: ABC News (US)
outlet.summary: ABC News in the United States, the network's national and world file is leading with Iran live updates: Trump says US is winning war, 'can leave right now'; LIVE: ABC News Live; What to know about changes to Medicare as open enrollment begins.

items.headline: Iran live updates: Trump says US is winning war, 'can leave right now'
items.detail: President Donald Trump announced "major combat operations" against Iran on Feb. 28.

items.headline: LIVE: ABC News Live
items.detail: 24/7 coverage of breaking news and live events

items.headline: What to know about changes to Medicare as open enrollment begins
items.detail: Open enrollment for Medicare, the nationwide federal health insurance program primarily for those aged 65 and older, began last week and there are some changes.

items.headline: France protests cool after overnight curfews in Paris, major cities, PM says
items.detail: French Prime Minister Sebastian Lecornu credited overnight curfews in Paris and other major cities for providing a measure of calm.

items.headline: WATCH: Study shows Gulf oil spill's lasting damage
items.detail: More than 16 years after the BP oil spill off the Gulf Coast, new research reveals lasting damage to marine life.
